name: Neckoffoods
description: The agricultural heart that supplies the Capital’s markets, people here are simple and hard-working, making most view this district as politically unimportant and merely a land of cultivation. In reality, respected and wise elders, as well as powerful retired heroes whom even Emperor Baleroth respects, live here as simple farmers. Because of the Braves Arena, it is common for aspiring adventurers to begin their career here, dreaming of ascending to grander arenas. It is there where the retired veterans often scout for talent, hoping to pass on their legacy. They offer budding adventurers quests to deal with unfinished businesses, old enemies, or unconquered hidden dungeons for valuable rewards—training, wisdom, and magic items from their adventuring times. What very few know is that beneath the peaceful surface of the Neckoffoods hides a cell of rebels against Baleroth, as righteous retired heroes gather the people in old barns to plot against the Empire.
